# Bootstrap Plan

lume — An educational tree-walking interpreter for teaching language design.

v0.1 implementation strategy: tree_walking_interpreter on a rust_host runtime.
Bootstrap order: lexer → parser → AST → tree-walking evaluator → REPL → CLI.
See ADR-0001 (host language) and ADR-0002 (impl strategy) for rationale.
